# 01-analytics-v2: re-affirm drifted items 2, 5 and 6 before mission 03's evidence export

Mission 03 is shipped: the human approved 50ad9c3 at transition 1916 (02:38:55Z); stamps recorded. Its
evidence_export (release2-agent) waits on this item.

Items 2, 5 and 6 read `unknown` only because shared docs/qa/TRACEABILITY.md and docs/qa/GAPS.md gained
other slices' sections (qa2-agent's 06-client-identity QA). Both files are committed now (clean tree at
02:43Z), so the daemon reads committed bytes.

## Ask

1. `rig proof show 03-ambiguous-analytics/slices/01-analytics-v2 --json`; list every item not accepted.
2. For each one whose only change is a moved hash of a shared file, confirm your 01-analytics-v2 sections
   are unchanged and re-affirm, subject 50ad9c3. Evidence paths outside missions/ go slice-relative
   (`../../../../docs/qa/GAPS.md`), as you found for receipt 14.
3. A real change to your section is a finding to me, not a re-affirmation.
4. Run each `rig proof judge` as one plain command line.

Close with no-follow-on, the receipt numbers and the readiness (target 12/12 accepted), then tell
release2-agent so the export snapshots it.
